description: This file defines the EmpEmergencyContactDecorator class, a PHP class within the OrangeHRM project. It acts as a decorator for the EmpEmergencyContact entity, providing methods to set related employee data and integrating ORM helper traits.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the EmpEmergencyContact entity that enables setting associated employee data through ORM helper methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmpEmergencyContact instance.

methods.name: getEmpEmergencyContact
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the wrapped EmpEmergencyContact entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity on the EmpEmergencyContact based on an employee number.
